verdict.rationale: The docs show LibreChat connecting to several providers: OpenAI-compatible services, Anthropic-compatible endpoints via `provider: "anthropic"`, and custom providers like OpenRouter and Ollama configured in librechat.yaml. Agents are documented as "powered by various model providers", and the interface has an endpoint menu inside one unified UI, which supports choosing a model per agent. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence of Google/Gemini support, no explicit documentation of switching models mid-conversation (only implied by the endpoint menu), and no independent hands-on corroboration of multi-provider switching.
